decisions.reason: The Statement and proof already distinguish n=c^-1 partial_t, g(n,n)=-1, from gamma_x(t) with U=partial_t and g(U,U)=-c^2. The proper-time density is c and the increment is t1-t0; the title incorrectly calls these cosmic-time curves unit-speed. Retitled precisely without changing Statement/Definition. Also corrected the assigned empty-domain worksheet: Sigma can be empty and pointwise claims are vacuous. Aligned the two L4 contract quotations to current proper-time supplier clauses; focused strict contract check passes.

L1 attributed smoothness to thm-real-power-continuity-and-derivatives, whose Statement supplies only continuity and first derivatives. A smooth Friedmann datum requires every derivative. Replaced that restatement with the exact supplier claim and proved locally by induction D^m(u^alpha)=t_star^-m product_{r<m}(alpha-r) u^(alpha-m), with continuous right side for every m, including zero coefficients. Apply alpha=q and alpha=-2 to a and epsilon; p is a constant multiple. The unchanged checks of F,A,C,S reduce to 3q(1+w)=2; all divisions use t>t0, c,G_N,t_star>0 and q>0. No new prerequisite or interface change.

Step 2.3 used the four-dimensional index d in spatial gamma^{id} and gamma_{jd}, which are defined only for d=1,2,3, and incorrectly said g_{0d}=0 without that restriction. The result is correct: g^{i0}=0 removes the temporal summand, after which partial_0 g_{jd}=2a adot gamma_{jd} and the spatial inverse identity yield Gamma^i_0j=H delta^i_j. Made this restriction explicit; checked all other index families directly against the current Levi-Civita formula. Statement and dependencies unchanged. Corrected assigned contract zero boundary (individual inverse entries may vanish); aligned the L1/L3 quotations to current Levi-Civita clause (a); focused strict contract check passes.

The redshift theorem first derives constancy of a V^t from the metric and future affine null-geodesic rule, then uses n=c^-1 partial_t and E=-c g(V,n) to obtain the observer-energy ratio; z is defined by 1+z=E_E/E_R. The scope note omitted these definitions by saying metric and light-ray rule alone. Added precisely these prerequisites, without a field equation, observational premise or numerical uncertainty. The note continues to distinguish conditional model predictions, apparatus-dependent observations and statistical inference; neither agreement nor a p-value is presented as proof of the model.
